scientific_limitations: A sharp result for the field of five elements only, not a uniform formula or a classification of all degree-four curves. The lower-degree nonexistence step is an exhaustive finite census of all coefficient classes; the witness smoothness is proved algebraically over the closure.
title: Sharp tangent-filling degree over \(\mathbf F_5\)
